retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered urban composition featuring a group of subjects in white attire against a textured, warm-toned background with oversized, semi-transparent typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A group of four men in white casual clothing are seated in an informal urban setting. The image is framed by a thick, distressed yellow border and features heavy layering of large, semi-transparent sans-serif letters that overlap the subjects and the background. The color palette is dominated by ochre, mustard, and deep red, with a grimy, textured finish.
coreVisualRelationships: Large vertical letters on the left act as a structural frame for the central group.
The white clothing of the subjects provides a high-value focal point against the dark, textured background.
Horizontal text at the bottom anchors the composition and balances the vertical elements.
Distressed borders and overlays create a sense of depth and urban grit.
coreInvariants: Warm ochre and mustard yellow background tones.
Subjects wearing all-white or light-colored clothing.
Layered, semi-transparent typography that interacts with the photographic plane.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects are clustered in the center-right, scaled to occupy about 60% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, vertical 'S' on the top left and the solid red text block at the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large vertical letters on the left, move across the subjects' faces, and finish on the bottom text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the space is filled with textures, color washes, and typographic overlays.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mustard yellow and ochre (background and borders).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White (subject clothing) and Black (shadows and small text).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep brick red (bottom text) and teal/green (floor texture).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellows and reds; low value in the background shadows to make the white clothing pop.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical letters on the left are scaled to massive proportions and set to approximately 30% opacity.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying scales and opacities of the same typeface family.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, urban feel of the display text.
Provides the necessary grotesque structure with a slightly more modern feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of four men in white casual clothes sitting in an urban alleyway. Apply a heavy mustard-yellow color wash and grunge textures. Add a thick, distressed yellow border with paint-splatter effects.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place large, semi-transparent condensed sans-serif letters vertically on the left side. Add the main title in bold red condensed sans-serif at the bottom right, slightly overlapping a black horizontal bar.

verificationChecks: Is the typography layered with transparency?
Are the subjects wearing white to contrast the warm background?
Is the overall texture distressed and grimy?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the yellow border
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific band name or logos.
Ensure the faces of the subjects are generic and not recognizable celebrities.
postGenerationChecks: Verify the red text at the bottom is legible against the background.
Ensure the vertical letters on the left do not obscure the subjects' faces.
Check that the grunge border looks organic and not like a simple frame.
Confirm the white clothing is the brightest element in the image.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Group Portrait + Mustard/Ochre Wash + Oversized Transparent Sans-Serif + Grunge Border
